scripts.mobile:sync: npm run build && cap sync android
scripts.mobile:apk: npm run mobile:sync && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
scripts.deploy:cloudflare: npm run lint && npm test && node tests/preserve-deployed-assets.mjs && npm run build && npm --prefix worker ci && npm --prefix worker run deploy
scripts.deploy:staging: node tests/preserve-deployed-assets.mjs && npm run build:preview && npx --prefix worker wrangler versions upload --config worker/wrangler.toml --profile rameng --keep-vars --preview-alias staging
scripts.upload:preview: npm run build:preview && npx --prefix worker wrangler versions upload --config worker/wrangler.toml --preview-alias meeting-crm
